title: Unify shard negotiator and tokenizer lifecycle hooks
creator: Priya Nair
description: Problem: The current model ingest pipeline has three separate coordination points: weight manifest parsing (multiple formats), shard negotiation, and a loose tokenizer init handshake. This leads to race conditions during cold starts (double deserializations), inconsistent memory accounting when activating lazy shards, and complicated workarounds in the serving runtime. Scope: introduce a single 'Shard Negotiator' API that centralizes shard assignment, activation lifecycle, and exposes deterministic tokenizer readiness signals. Also add a manifest v2 schema to canonicalize safetensors/legacy formats and upgrade our tokenizer adapter protocol (v2) to permit staged initialization and safe rebinds. Out-of-scope: full on-disk format conversion of customer artifacts (we'll provide canonical mapping/adapters).
acceptance_criteria: Introduce Shard Negotiator library (runtime module) with public API for: probe(manifest), propose(shard_map), activate(shard_id, mode), release(shard_id)
Manifest v2 parser that normalizes safetensors, legacy checkpoint manifests, and produces a canonical weight-index used by the negotiator
Tokenizer adapter v2 that emits readiness events and supports lazy token vocabulary patching without global restarts
End-to-end integration tests covering: concurrent bootstrap (100 simulated clients), forced shard eviction, and tokenizer rebind during serving
Benchmark: reduce median cold-start model load time for 2B-8B models by >=30% and peak per-node memory by >=15% in our internal harness
Documentation: design doc, API reference, and migration guide for private customers
benchmarks: Baseline (2026-01): cold-start median 8.2s for 4B model, peak mem 62GB/node
Current dev branch (after partial refactor): cold-start median 5.6s for 4B model, peak mem 52GB/node
Target: cold-start <=5.7s and peak mem <=53GB/node across 2B-8B families
notes: Trade-offs: centralizing negotiation simplifies lifecycle but adds a single coordination hop; mitigated with lightweight local caches and optimistic activation paths
We keep adapters for legacy manifests but will mark them deprecated and emit migration warnings during ingest
Tokenizer v2 avoids full vocab rebinds by supporting delta patches; this required minor changes in existing tokenizers (backwards-compatible wrapper provided)
We intentionally do NOT change on-disk weight formats in this ticket to avoid customer-impacting migrations; instead we canonicalize at load time
